storage: Unopened: cool, dry cupboard. Opened: fold and clip the pack, put it in an airtight jar and keep it in the fridge (a few months) or freezer (longer). Keep it away from moisture; a wet spoon will spoil it.
looksLike: Fine, pale beige-brown granules, sold in small sachets, cartons or vacuum-packed bricks. It smells faintly of bread.
shelfLife: Unopened, until the date on the pack (usually many months). Opened, it loses strength over weeks at room temperature.
substitutes: Toddy (palm wine) or a long natural ferment

usedIn.raw: 0.5 g (a small pinch, about ⅛ tsp, in the batter)
